title: Slab three contracts to seventeen exact terminal boxes but remains globally open
next_gate: On the seventeen retained boxes, use cancellation-preserving gradient or value enclosures and an exhaustive face/corner census to connect the local Krawczyk box to a complete slab-three uniqueness theorem.
scope_guard: The seventeen boxes are the degree-nine unresolved frontier. They neither create additional stationary points nor prove that the isolated local point exhausts slab three.
